title: Granite Lower
description: Two classic lower body and core blocks: goblet squat, single-leg hip thrust and dead bug

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm to the sky

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, rotate from side to side

exercises.name: Bodyweight goblet squat
exercises.instructions: Hands in front of chest, squat deep

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Hip thrust on one leg, the other in the air

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate left foot forward then right foot forward without pausing

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs in the air, extend opposite arm/leg alternating

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions: On one forearm, body aligned, hips high

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, touch feet with hands

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
